title: Audit R3 correction to the governed async replan provider — canonical Objective budget admission now reconciles outstanding planner reservations (flag unchanged, default OFF)
description: Audit R3 on PR #118: the R2 canonical budget check used consumed+est<=ceiling but ignored outstanding reservations — two 80µ planner admissions under ceiling=100 both passed (160 combined). admitPlannerInvocation now sums HELD/COMMITTED reservations traceable to the objective (same lineage walk as the auto-policy seam, filtered to encumbering statuses) inside the same atomic reservation transaction: consumed+outstanding+est must fit ceiling, else FAIL_CLOSED_COST_OBJECTIVE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED with an event pinning consumed/outstanding/requested. SETTLED rows are excluded because their spend is already the canonical consumed_microusd authority — counting them again would double-count settled costs; RELEASED rows carry no encumbrance. Zero-budget, unbounded-cost, absent-row/legacy-lineage and idempotent-replay semantics unchanged: the idempotent existing-row replay still returns first, ceiling=0 still hard-blocks spend-bearing envelopes, malformed canonical authority still fails closed UNVERIFIED.
